question: How many Garole lambs were used, how were they grouped, and how long did the growth trial last?
expect: 18 lambs, 3 groups of 6 (control, T1, T2), 105 days (p1 abstract; p2 methods)
rendered: Eighteen young Garole lambs were used. They were divided into three groups (control, T1, and T2) of six lambs each. The lambs were randomly distributed into the groups to ensure that their initial body weights were almost similar. The growth trial lasted for 105 days.
